def _ind(body: str) -> str:
    lines = [line.rstrip() for line in (body or "").splitlines()]
    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
        lines.pop()
    if not lines:
        return ""
    if lines[0] and not lines[0][0].isspace():
        lines = ["    " + line if line else line for line in lines]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _generate(model, tokenizer, prompt):
    from serving.local_inference import generate_ids

    result = generate_ids(
        model, tokenizer, prompt,
        max_new_tokens=48, temperature=0.0, top_k=1, top_p=1.0,
        device="cpu", seed=20261023, binding_repair=False,
    )
    return result["text"]


def _transform(gate, generator, instruction, signature, completion, mode, tokenizer):
    if mode == "model":
        return completion
    if mode == "adapter":
        return copy_generate(gate, instruction, signature, completion, tokenizer)["rewritten"]
    return generator.generate(instruction, signature)["completion"]


def _behavior_record(case, completion, reference_body):
    from evaluation.functional_eval import evaluate_functional as _ef

    expected = analyse(case["signature"], reference_body)
    generated = analyse(case["signature"], _ind(completion))
    functional = _ef(case["signature"] + "\n" + _ind(completion) if completion.lstrip().startswith("def ") is False else completion,
                     case["function_name"], case["tests"])
    return {
        "case_id": case["case_id"],
        "behavior": case.get("behavior", case.get("kind")),
        "parses": bool(generated["parses"]),
        "exact": bool(generated["parses"] and generated["body_dump"] == expected["body_dump"]),
        "structural": bool(generated["parses"] and expected["operations"] and set(expected["operations"]).issubset(set(generated["operations"]))),
        "binding": bool(generated["parses"] and generated["params_used"] == expected["params_used"] and not generated["undefined_names"]),
        "functional": {"passed": functional.passed, "reason": functional.reason},
        "completion": completion,
    }


def evaluate_all(model, tokenizer, mode):
    gate = CopyGate(enabled=(mode != "model"))
    generator = HybridGenerator(model, tokenizer, enabled=(mode in ("hybrid", "hybrid122")))
    ad1_suite = json.loads(AD1_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    c3_suite = json.loads(C3_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    copy_records, supp_records, gen_records, new_records, ad1_records, c3_records = [], [], [], [], [], []
    for case_id, kind, instruction, signature, _fragment in COPY_CASES:
        completion = _generate(model, tokenizer, instruction + "\n" + signature + "\n")
        final = _transform(gate, generator, instruction, signature, completion, mode, tokenizer)
        scored = score_copy_case(kind, signature, final)
        scored.update({"case_id": case_id, "completion": final})
        copy_records.append(scored)
    suites = [
        (build_supp(), supp_records), (build_gen(), gen_records),
        (build_v123(), new_records),
    ]
    for cases, sink in suites:
        for case in cases:
            completion = _generate(model, tokenizer, case["instruction"] + "\n" + case["signature"] + "\n")
            if case.get("expected_abstain"):
                pass
            final = _transform(gate, generator, case["instruction"], case["signature"], completion, mode, tokenizer)
            rec = _behavior_record(case, final, case["reference_body"])
            rec["expected_abstain"] = case.get("expected_abstain", False)
            if rec["expected_abstain"]:
                rec["abstained"] = final == completion and mode != "model"
                rec["functional"] = {"passed": None, "reason": "abstention_expected"}
            sink.append(rec)
    for case in ad1_suite["cases"]:
        from scripts.evaluate_v120_increment1 import score_ad1_case

        completion = _generate(model, tokenizer, case["instruction"] + "\n" + case["signature"] + "\n")
        final = _transform(gate, generator, case["instruction"], case["signature"], completion, mode, tokenizer)
        ad1_records.append(score_ad1_case(case, final))
    for case in c3_suite["cases"]:
        from scripts.evaluate_v120_increment1 import score_c3_case

        completion = _generate(model, tokenizer, case["instruction"] + "\n" + case["signature"] + "\n")
        final = _transform(gate, generator, case["instruction"], case["signature"], completion, mode, tokenizer)
        c3_records.append(score_c3_case(case, final))
    return {
        "copy": copy_records,
        "copy_report": copy_report(copy_records),
        "supplemental": supp_records,
        "supplemental_report": functional_report([r for r in supp_records if not r["expected_abstain"]] or supp_records),
        "generalization": gen_records,
        "generalization_report": functional_report(gen_records),
        "new_independent": new_records,
        "ad1": ad1_records,
        "c3": c3_records,
    }


def op_selection_probe(model, tokenizer) -> dict:
    """Neural operation-selection: teacher-forced operation-token ranks."""
    import torch

    probes = [
        ("sum", "Return the sum of two numbers.", "def f(left_value, right_value):"),
        ("difference", "Return the difference between two numbers.", "def f(left_value, right_value):"),
        ("product", "Return the product of two numbers.", "def f(left_value, right_value):"),
        ("upper", "Return the text in upper case.", "def f(raw_text):"),
        ("lower", "Return the text in lower case.", "def f(raw_text):"),
        ("count", "Count the items in a list.", "def f(item_values):"),
        ("sum", "Sum the items in a list.", "def f(item_values):"),
        ("even", "Check whether the number is even.", "def f(number_value):"),
    ]
    observations = []
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for expected_op, instruction, signature in probes:
            sequence = instruction + "\n" + signature + "\n    return "
            ids = list(tokenizer.encode(sequence, add_special_tokens=False).ids)
            logits, _ = model(torch.tensor([ids], dtype=torch.long))
            probs = torch.softmax(logits[0, -1].float(), dim=-1)
            top_ids = torch.topk(probs, 5).indices.tolist()
            top_tokens = [tokenizer.id_to_token(t) for t in top_ids]
            observations.append({
                "instruction": instruction,
                "expected_operation": expected_op,
                "top_tokens": top_tokens,
            })
    return {"observations": observations}


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="v1.2.3 qualification")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", default=str(BASELINE))
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
    from serving.local_inference import load_model

    import torch

    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(REPO / "tokenizer" / "qm_code_bpe_v0.json"))
    model, _config = load_model(str(args.checkpoint), "cpu")
    modes = {}
    try:
        modes["model"] = evaluate_all(model, tokenizer, "model")
        gate_adapter = CopyGate(enabled=True)
        modes["adapter"] = evaluate_all(model, tokenizer, "adapter")
        modes["hybrid"] = evaluate_all(model, tokenizer, "hybrid")
        # Constrained POC over copy probes (syntax layer comparison).
        constrained_prompts = []
        for case_id, kind, instruction, signature, fragment in COPY_CASES:
            constrained_prompts.append((case_id, instruction + "\n" + signature + "\n"))
        constrained_runs = []
        for case_id, prompt in constrained_prompts:
            result = generate_constrained(model, tokenizer, prompt)
            constrained_runs.append({
                "case_id": case_id,
                "completion": result["completion"],
                "interventions": result["interventions"],
            })
        op_selection = op_selection_probe(model, tokenizer)
    finally:
        del model
        gc.collect()
    result = {
        "checkpoint": str(args.checkpoint),
        **modes,
        "constrained_copy_probes": constrained_runs,
        "op_selection": op_selection,
    }
    output = Path(args.out)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for mode in ("model", "adapter", "hybrid"):
        side = result[mode]
        supp = sum(r["functional"]["passed"] is True for r in side["supplemental"])
        gen = sum(r["functional"]["passed"] is True for r in side["generalization"])
        new_reg = [r for r in side["new_independent"] if not r["expected_abstain"]]
        new_func = sum(r["functional"]["passed"] is True for r in new_reg)
        print(json.dumps({
            mode: {
                "copy": side["copy_report"]["all"]["exact_copy"],
                "supp": supp, "gen": gen,
                "new_functional": new_func,
                "ad1": [sum(r["parses"] for r in side["ad1"]), sum(r["binding"] for r in side["ad1"])],
                "c3": [sum(r["parses"] for r in side["c3"]), sum(r["binding"] for r in side["c3"]), sum(r["functional"]["passed"] is True for r in side["c3"])],
            }
        }))
    print("op_selection_first2", json.dumps(op_selection["observations"][:2], ensure_ascii=True)[:400])
    print("constrained_interventions", sum(len(r["interventions"]) for r in constrained_runs))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<|file|> F:\Codes\Git\Quantsmind-LLM\scripts\run_binding_repair_qualification.py
"""Run the frozen binding-repair qualification suite with the S2 checkpoint.

No generated code is executed except for explicitly approved, pure fixture
cases in the frozen dataset. Unsupported/ambiguous cases are never executed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from serving.local_inference import generate_ids, load_model
from training.binding_repair import repair_from_prompt
from training.generalization_eval import _indent
from training.program_analysis import analyse
from evaluation.safe_execute import execute_tests

DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT = Path(r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\v210\runE\checkpoints\trained.pt")
DEFAULT_TOKENIZER = REPO / "tokenizer" / "qm_code_bpe_v0.json"
SUITE = REPO / "evaluation" / "binding_repair_qualification_v1.json"
EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT = "02cc86eb64022a454c0c7a795f18507cebbde709f295c65cd990d5e6f837f8ac"
EXPECTED_SUITE_SHA = "961936f8b5f098e0d9d863a8753d7430929ba87b0a6880fe27acb81c461f3d2f"


def file_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    import hashlib

    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def canonical_digest(cases: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(cases, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def score_static(case: dict[str, Any], completion: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    expected = analyse(case["signature"], case["reference_body"])
    generated = analyse(case["signature"], _indent(completion))
    exact = bool(generated["parses"] and expected["parses"]
                 and generated["body_dump"] == expected["body_dump"])
    reference_ops = set(expected["operations"])
    generated_ops = set(generated["operations"])
    if reference_ops:
        structural: bool | None = bool(generated["parses"] and reference_ops.issubset(generated_ops))
    else:
        structural = None
    binding = bool(generated["parses"]
                   and generated["params_used"] == expected["params_used"]
                   and not generated["undefined_names"])
    if case.get("negative"):
        exact = False
        structural = False
    return {
        "parses": bool(generated["parses"]),
        "error": generated["error"],
        "exact": exact,
        "structural": structural,
        "binding": binding,
        "operations": sorted(generated_ops),
        "reference_operations": expected["operations"],
        "undefined_names": generated["undefined_names"],
    }


def source_for(case: dict[str, Any], completion: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    stripped = completion.lstrip()
    if stripped.startswith("def "):
        return completion, "full_function"
    return case["signature"] + "\n" + _indent(completion), "body"


def run_case(model, tokenizer, case: dict[str, Any], binding_repair: bool):
    prompt = case["instruction"] + "\n" + case["signature"] + "\n"
    result = generate_ids(
        model, tokenizer, prompt,
        max_new_tokens=64, temperature=0.0, top_k=1, top_p=1.0,
        device="cpu", seed=20261023, binding_repair=binding_repair,
    )
    completion = result["text"]
    static = score_static(case, completion)
    functional = {"passed": None, "reason": "not_executed"}
    if case.get("execution_safe") and not case.get("negative"):
        source, form = source_for(case, completion)
        execution = execute_tests(source, case["function_name"], case["tests"])
        functional = {"passed": execution.passed, "reason": execution.reason,
                      "source_form": form}
    return {
        "case_id": case["case_id"],
        "category": case["category"],
        "negative": bool(case.get("negative")),
        "prompt": prompt,
        "completion": completion,
        "binding_repair": binding_repair,
        "finish_reason": result["finish_reason"],
        "tokens": result["completion_tokens"],
        **static,
        "functional": functional,
        "repair": result.get("repair", {}),
    }


def summarize(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    total = len(records)
    structural = [r for r in records if r["structural"] is not None]
    positives = [r for r in records if not r["negative"]]
    return {
        "cases": total,
        "parses": sum(bool(r["parses"]) for r in records),
        "exact": sum(bool(r["exact"]) for r in records),
        "structural": sum(r["structural"] is True for r in structural),
        "structural_cases": len(structural),
        "binding": sum(bool(r["binding"]) for r in records),
        "negative_safe": sum(1 for r in records
                             if r["negative"] and not r["exact"] and not r["structural"]),
        "negative_cases": sum(1 for r in records if r["negative"]),
        "functional_passed": sum(1 for r in records if r["functional"]["passed"] is True),
        "functional_failed": sum(1 for r in records if r["functional"]["passed"] is False),
        "functional_cases": sum(1 for r in records if r["functional"]["passed"] is not None),
        "positive_cases": len(positives),
        "exact_rate": round(sum(bool(r["exact"]) for r in records) / total, 4),
        "structural_rate": round(
            sum(r["structural"] is True for r in structural) / len(structural), 4
        ) if structural else None,
        "binding_rate": round(sum(bool(r["binding"]) for r in records) / total, 4),
        "functional_rate": round(
            sum(r["functional"]["passed"] is True for r in records
                if r["functional"]["passed"] is not None)
            / max(1, sum(r["functional"]["passed"] is not None for r in records)), 4
        ),
    }


def paired(raw: list[dict[str, Any]], repaired: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    lookup = {r["case_id"]: r for r in raw}
    lookup_r = {r["case_id"]: r for r in repaired}
    changed = sum(1 for k in lookup if lookup[k]["completion"] != lookup_r[k]["completion"])
    improved = {
        metric: sum(1 for k in lookup
                    if bool(lookup_r[k][metric]) and not bool(lookup[k][metric]))
        for metric in ("parses", "exact", "binding")
    }
    regressions = {
        metric: sum(1 for k in lookup
                    if bool(lookup[k][metric]) and not bool(lookup_r[k][metric]))
        for metric in ("parses", "exact", "binding")
    }
    changed_negative = sum(
        1 for k in lookup if lookup[k]["negative"] and lookup[k]["completion"] != lookup_r[k]["completion"]
    )
    return {
        "changed": changed,
        "changed_negative": changed_negative,
        "improved": improved,
        "regressions": regressions,
        "changed_rate": round(changed / len(lookup), 4),
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", default=str(DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT))
    parser.add_argument("--suite", default=str(SUITE))
    parser.add_argument("--expected-sha", default=EXPECTED_SUITE_SHA)
    parser.add_argument("--out", default=r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\ad1\binding_repair_qualification_results.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    suite_path = Path(args.suite)
    expected_sha = args.expected_sha.lower()
    suite = json.loads(suite_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    suite_sha = file_sha256(suite_path)
    if suite_sha != expected_sha:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: qualification dataset hash does not match expected SHA-256")
    if canonical_digest(suite["cases"]) != suite["digest"]:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: qualification dataset digest changed")
    checkpoint_sha = file_sha256(Path(args.checkpoint))
    if checkpoint_sha != EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: checkpoint hash does not match frozen S2")

    from tokenizers import Tokenizer

    tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(DEFAULT_TOKENIZER))
    model, _config = load_model(args.checkpoint, "cpu")

    raw_records, repaired_records = [], []
    for case in suite["cases"]:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        raw_records.append(run_case(model, tokenizer, case, binding_repair=False))
        raw_records[-1]["latency_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - started
    for case in suite["cases"]:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        repaired_records.append(run_case(model, tokenizer, case, binding_repair=True))
        repaired_records[-1]["latency_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - started

    def abstentions(records):
        counts = {}
        for record in records:
            status = record.get("repair", {}).get("status", "unknown")
            counts[status] = counts.get(status, 0) + 1
        return counts

    def latency(records):
        values = [record["latency_seconds"] for record in records]
        if not values:
            return None
        mean = sum(values) / len(values)
        return {"mean_seconds": mean, "median_seconds": sorted(values)[len(values) // 2]}

    raw_summary = summarize(raw_records)
    repaired_summary = summarize(repaired_records)
    result = {
        "suite": suite["suite"],
        "suite_version": suite["version"],
        "suite_sha256": suite_sha,
        "suite_digest": suite["digest"],
        "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_sha,
        "tokenizer": str(DEFAULT_TOKENIZER),
        "decoding": suite["decoding"],
        "executed_fixture_cases_only": True,
        "records": {"raw": raw_records, "repaired": repaired_records},
        "summary": {"raw": raw_summary, "repaired": repaired_summary},
        "repair": {
            "statuses": {
                "raw": abstentions(raw_records),
                "repaired": abstentions(repaired_records),
            },
            "latency_seconds": {
                "raw": latency(raw_records),
                "repaired": latency(repaired_records),
            },
        },
        "paired": paired(raw_records, repaired_records),
    }
    output = Path(args.out)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({
        "out": str(output),
        "raw": result["summary"]["raw"],
        "repaired": result["summary"]["repaired"],
        "paired": result["paired"],
    }, indent=2))

<|file|> F:\Codes\Git\Quantsmind-LLM\scripts\run_provider_qualification.py
"""Offline provider qualification harness.

Records provider identity and metrics for the frozen suites. Only the built-in
Taksh S2 provider can execute checkpoints. Foundation placeholders report an
unavailable status and never download weights or call hosted endpoints.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from evaluation.safe_execute import execute_tests
from scripts.run_binding_repair_qualification import (
    canonical_digest,
    file_sha256,
    score_static,
)
from serving.providers import (
    GenerationConfig,
    GenerationRequest,
    ProviderTimeoutError,
    ProviderUnavailableError,
    get_provider,
    qualification_metadata,
)

DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT = Path(r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\v210\runE\checkpoints\trained.pt")
DEFAULT_TOKENIZER = REPO / "tokenizer" / "qm_code_bpe_v0.json"
EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT = "02cc86eb64022a454c0c7a795f18507cebbde709f295c65cd990d5e6f837f8ac"


def source_for(case, completion: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if completion.lstrip().startswith("def "):
        return completion, "full_function"
    from training.generalization_eval import _indent

    return case["signature"] + "\n" + _indent(completion), "body"


def evaluate_case(
    provider,
    case,
    *,
    binding_repair: bool,
    timeout_seconds: float,
    max_new_tokens: int = 64,
    top_k: int = 1,
    top_p: float = 1.0,
    seed: int = 20261023,
):
    prompt = case["instruction"] + "\n" + case["signature"] + "\n"
    config = GenerationConfig(
        max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
        temperature=0.0,
        top_k=top_k,
        top_p=top_p,
        seed=seed,
        timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
        binding_repair=binding_repair,
        language="python",
    )
    request = GenerationRequest(prompt=prompt, config=config, metadata={"case_id": case["case_id"]})
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        from serving.providers import generate_with_timeout

        result = generate_with_timeout(provider, request)
    except (ProviderUnavailableError, ProviderTimeoutError) as exc:
        return {
            "case_id": case["case_id"],
            "category": case["category"],
            "negative": bool(case.get("negative")),
            "prompt": prompt,
            "completion": "",
            "raw_text": "",
            "provider_status": "unavailable" if isinstance(exc, ProviderUnavailableError) else "timeout",
            "provider_error": {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)},
            "binding_repair": binding_repair,
            "latency_seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
            "parses": False,
            "exact": False,
            "structural": None,
            "binding": False,
            "functional": {"passed": None, "reason": "provider_not_executed"},
            "repair": {},
        }

    completion = result.text
    record = {
        "case_id": case["case_id"],
        "category": case["category"],
        "negative": bool(case.get("negative")),
        "prompt": prompt,
        "completion": completion,
        "raw_text": result.raw_text,
        "provider_status": "completed",
        "binding_repair": binding_repair,
        "finish_reason": result.finish_reason,
        "tokens": result.completion_tokens,
        "latency_seconds": result.latency_seconds,
        **score_static(case, completion),
        "functional": {"passed": None, "reason": "not_executed"},
        "repair": result.repair,
    }
    if case.get("execution_safe") and not case.get("negative"):
        source, form = source_for(case, completion)
        execution = execute_tests(source, case["function_name"], case["tests"])
        record["functional"] = {
            "passed": execution.passed,
            "reason": execution.reason,
            "source_form": form,
        }
    return record


def summarize(records):
    attempted = [record for record in records if record["provider_status"] == "completed"]
    functional = [record for record in attempted if record["functional"]["passed"] is not None]
    structural = [record for record in attempted if record["structural"] is not None]
    return {
        "cases": len(records),
        "completed": len(attempted),
        "unavailable": sum(1 for record in records if record["provider_status"] == "unavailable"),
        "timed_out": sum(1 for record in records if record["provider_status"] == "timeout"),
        "parses": sum(bool(record["parses"]) for record in attempted),
        "exact": sum(bool(record["exact"]) for record in attempted),
        "structural": sum(record["structural"] is True for record in structural),
        "structural_cases": len(structural),
        "binding": sum(bool(record["binding"]) for record in attempted),
        "functional_passed": sum(record["functional"]["passed"] is True for record in functional),
        "functional_cases": len(functional),
        "abstentions": sum(1 for record in attempted if record.get("repair", {}).get("status", "").startswith("abstained")),
        "repairs": sum(1 for record in attempted if record.get("repair", {}).get("status") == "repaired"),
        "negative_cases": sum(1 for record in records if record["negative"]),
        "negative_safe": sum(
            1 for record in attempted
            if record["negative"] and not record["exact"] and record["structural"] is not True
        ),
    }


def build_provider(
    provider_name: str,
    *,
    model_path: str | None = None,
    revision: str | None = None,
    device: str = "cpu",
    dtype: str = "auto",
    expected_artifact_sha256: str | None = None,
):
    if provider_name != "taksh-s2":
        if provider_name == "seed-coder-8b-instruct":
            kwargs = {}
            if model_path is not None:
                kwargs["model_path"] = model_path
            if revision is not None:
                kwargs["revision"] = revision
            if device is not None:
                kwargs["device"] = device
            if dtype is not None:
                kwargs["dtype"] = dtype
            if expected_artifact_sha256 is not None:
                kwargs["expected_artifact_sha256"] = expected_artifact_sha256
            return get_provider(provider_name, **kwargs)
        return get_provider(provider_name)
    checkpoint_sha = file_sha256(DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT)
    if checkpoint_sha != EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: checkpoint hash does not match frozen S2")
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer

    from serving.local_inference import load_model

    model, _config = load_model(str(DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT), "cpu")
    tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(DEFAULT_TOKENIZER))
    return get_provider(
        "taksh-s2",
        model=model,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        model_id="taksh-s2",
        revision=checkpoint_sha,
        source=str(DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT),
        artifact_sha256=checkpoint_sha,
        tokenizer_path=str(DEFAULT_TOKENIZER),
    )


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Offline provider qualification")
    parser.add_argument("--provider", default="taksh-s2")
    parser.add_argument("--suite", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-sha", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--binding-repair", choices=["true", "false"], default="true")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=120.0)
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--revision", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cpu")
    parser.add_argument("--dtype", default="auto")
    parser.add_argument("--expected-artifact-sha256", default=None)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out",
        default=r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\ad1\provider_qualification_results.json",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    suite_path = Path(args.suite)
    suite_sha = file_sha256(suite_path)
    if suite_sha != args.expected_sha.lower():
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: suite SHA-256 does not match expected hash")
    suite = json.loads(suite_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if canonical_digest(suite["cases"]) != suite["digest"]:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: suite canonical digest changed")

    provider = build_provider(
        args.provider,
        model_path=args.model_path,
        revision=args.revision,
        device=args.device,
        dtype=args.dtype,
        expected_artifact_sha256=args.expected_artifact_sha256,
    )
    metadata = qualification_metadata(
        provider,
        suite_version=suite["version"],
        suite_sha256=suite_sha,
        config=GenerationConfig(binding_repair=(args.binding_repair == "true")),
    )
    if hasattr(provider, "artifact_hashes"):
        metadata["artifact_hashes"] = provider.artifact_hashes()
    records = [
        evaluate_case(
            provider,
            case,
            binding_repair=(args.binding_repair == "true"),
            timeout_seconds=args.timeout,
        )
        for case in suite["cases"]
    ]
    result = {
        "provider_qualification_version": "1.0.0",
        "suite": suite["suite"],
        "suite_version": suite["version"],
        "suite_sha256": suite_sha,
        "suite_digest": suite["digest"],
        "provider_metadata": metadata,
        "binding_repair": args.binding_repair == "true",
        "executed_fixture_cases_only": True,
        "records": records,
        "summary": summarize(records),
    }
    output = Path(args.out)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"out": str(output), "summary": result["summary"],
                      "provider_metadata": result["provider_metadata"]["provider_identity"]}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<|file|> F:\Codes\Git\Quantsmind-LLM\scripts\run_seed_coder_cloud_workflow.py
"""Reproducible Seed-Coder cloud execution workflow (D3.1).

Default mode prints a plan and performs no execution. Real execution requires
--execute, a local model directory, a frozen suite, and passing preflight.
It never downloads weights, calls hosted services, or falls back to S2.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from scripts.preflight_seed_coder_cloud import preflight
from scripts.run_provider_qualification import (
    build_provider,
    canonical_digest,
    evaluate_case,
    file_sha256,
    summarize,
)
from serving.providers import qualification_metadata

SEED_CODER_PROVIDER = "seed-coder-8b-instruct"


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _plan(args) -> dict:
    return {
        "mode": "plan_only",
        "provider": SEED_CODER_PROVIDER,
        "model_path": str(args.model_path) if args.model_path else None,
        "suite": str(args.suite),
        "expected_suite_sha256": args.expected_sha,
        "output_directory": str(args.out_dir),
        "resource_controls": {
            "max_new_tokens": args.max_new_tokens,
            "context_length": args.context_length,
            "batch_size": args.batch_size,
            "timeout_seconds": args.timeout,
            "device": args.device,
            "dtype": args.dtype,
        },
        "execution": {
            "steps": [
                "environment verification",
                "local model artifact availability check",
                "Seed-Coder initialization",
                "small generation smoke test",
                "AD-1 evaluation",
                "raw versus binding-repair comparison",
                "result and log export",
                "runtime shutdown and cleanup",
            ],
            "automatic_downloads": False,
            "provider_fallback": False,
            "hosted_inference": False,
        },
    }


def _run_one(
    provider,
    suite,
    *,
    binding_repair: bool,
    args,
    partial_records=None,
):
    records = []
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        for case in suite["cases"]:
            records.append(
                evaluate_case(
                    provider,
                    case,
                    binding_repair=binding_repair,
                    timeout_seconds=args.timeout,
                    max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                )
            )
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        if partial_records is not None:
            partial_records.extend(records)
        raise
    return records


def _write_json(path: Path, payload: dict) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Seed-Coder cloud execution workflow")
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--suite", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-sha", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=64)
    parser.add_argument("--context-length", type=int, default=8192)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=600.0)
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cpu")
    parser.add_argument("--dtype", default="auto")
    parser.add_argument("--expected-artifact-sha256", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-config-sha256", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-tokenizer-sha256", default=None)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not (1 <= args.max_new_tokens <= 512):
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: max_new_tokens must be between 1 and 512")
    if not (1 <= args.context_length <= 32768):
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: context_length must be between 1 and 32768")
    if args.batch_size != 1:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: Seed-Coder cloud workflow supports batch_size=1 only")
    if not args.out_dir:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: --out-dir is required")

    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps(_plan(args), indent=2))
        return

    suite_path = Path(args.suite)
    out_dir = Path(args.out_dir)
    suite_sha = file_sha256(suite_path)
    if suite_sha != args.expected_sha.lower():
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: suite SHA-256 does not match expected hash")
    suite = json.loads(suite_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if canonical_digest(suite["cases"]) != suite["digest"]:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: suite canonical digest changed")

    preflight_report = preflight(
        model_path=Path(args.model_path) if args.model_path else None,
        expected_config_sha256=args.expected_config_sha256,
        expected_tokenizer_sha256=args.expected_tokenizer_sha256,
    )
    _write_json(out_dir / "logs" / "preflight.json", preflight_report)
    if not preflight_report["ready"]:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: cloud preflight failed; see logs/preflight.json")

    provider = build_provider(
        SEED_CODER_PROVIDER,
        model_path=args.model_path,
        device=args.device,
        dtype=args.dtype,
        expected_artifact_sha256=args.expected_artifact_sha256,
    )
    metadata = qualification_metadata(
        provider,
        suite_version=suite["version"],
        suite_sha256=suite_sha,
    )
    if hasattr(provider, "artifact_hashes"):
        metadata["artifact_hashes"] = provider.artifact_hashes()
    _write_json(out_dir / "provider_metadata.json", metadata)

    started = _now()
    records = {"raw": [], "repaired": []}
    status = "completed"
    try:
        records["raw"] = _run_one(provider, suite, binding_repair=False, args=args)
        records["repaired"] = _run_one(provider, suite, binding_repair=True, args=args)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        status = "interrupted"
        raise
    finally:
        result = {
            "status": status,
            "provider_qualification_version": "1.0.0",
            "suite": suite["suite"],
            "suite_version": suite["version"],
            "suite_sha256": suite_sha,
            "suite_digest": suite["digest"],
            "provider_metadata": metadata,
            "resource_controls": {
                "max_new_tokens": args.max_new_tokens,
                "context_length": args.context_length,
                "batch_size": args.batch_size,
                "timeout_seconds": args.timeout,
                "device": args.device,
                "dtype": args.dtype,
            },
            "started_utc": started,
            "finished_utc": _now(),
            "records": records,
            "summary": {
                "raw": summarize(records["raw"]),
                "repaired": summarize(records["repaired"]),
            },
        }
        _write_json(out_dir / "results.json", result)
        _write_json(out_dir / "summary.json", result["summary"])
        _write_json(
            out_dir / "run_manifest.json",
            {
                "status": status,
                "started_utc": started,
                "finished_utc": result["finished_utc"],
                "suite_sha256": suite_sha,
                "provider": metadata["provider_identity"],
                "resource_controls": result["resource_controls"],
                "hosted_inference": False,
                "automatic_downloads": False,
                "provider_fallback": False,
            },
        )
    print(json.dumps({"out": str(out_dir), "summary": result["summary"]}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Run the bounded v1.2.0 Increment 1 training experiment.

Default mode is a dry run. Real training requires --train and an explicit
isolated experiment root. The frozen S2 checkpoint is never overwritten.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from training.binding_curriculum import build_training_examples, build_validation_examples, curriculum_digest
from training.continued_training import train_from_checkpoint
from training.experiment_artifacts import RunArtifacts, file_sha256

BASELINE = Path(r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\v210\runE\checkpoints\trained.pt")
BASELINE_SHA = "02cc86eb64022a454c0c7a795f18507cebbde709f295c65cd990d5e6f837f8ac"
TOKENIZER_PATH = REPO / "tokenizer" / "qm_code_bpe_v0.json"
AD1_SUITE = Path(r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\ad1\ad1_suite.json")
DEFAULT_ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\v120")


def _ad1_pairs() -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
    if not AD1_SUITE.is_file():
        return set()
    suite = json.loads(AD1_SUITE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return {(case["instruction"], case["signature"]) for case in suite.get("cases", [])}


def _check_overlap(examples) -> None:
    ad1 = _ad1_pairs()
    overlap = [
        example.example_id
        for example in examples
        if (example.instruction, example.signature) in ad1
    ]
    if overlap:
        raise ValueError(f"training examples overlap held-out AD-1 cases: {overlap[:5]}")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run Taksh v1.2.0 Increment 1")
    parser.add_argument("--train", action="store_true", help="execute the bounded training run")
    parser.add_argument("--root", default=str(DEFAULT_ROOT))
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", default="increment1-binding-240")
    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=240)
    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=1e-4)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261024)
    parser.add_argument("--min-available-gib", type=float, default=0.5)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not (1 <= args.steps <= 300):
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: steps must be between 1 and 300")
    if not BASELINE.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSED: baseline checkpoint missing: {BASELINE}")
    checkpoint_sha = file_sha256(BASELINE)
    if checkpoint_sha != BASELINE_SHA:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: baseline checkpoint hash does not match frozen S2")
    if not TOKENIZER_PATH.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSED: tokenizer missing: {TOKENIZER_PATH}")

    training_examples = build_training_examples(seed=args.seed)
    validation_examples = build_validation_examples(seed=args.seed + 1)
    _check_overlap(training_examples)
    try:
        import psutil
    except ImportError:
        psutil = None
    if psutil is not None:
        available_gib = psutil.virtual_memory().available / 1024**3
        if available_gib < args.min_available_gib:
            raise SystemExit(
                f"REFUSED: available RAM {available_gib:.2f} GiB is below {args.min_available_gib} GiB"
            )

    plan = {
        "mode": "train" if args.train else "dry_run",
        "baseline_checkpoint": str(BASELINE),
        "baseline_checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_sha,
        "tokenizer": str(TOKENIZER_PATH),
        "curriculum_digest": curriculum_digest(),
        "train_examples": len(training_examples),
        "validation_examples": len(validation_examples),
        "steps": args.steps,
        "lr": args.lr,
        "seed": args.seed,
        "experiment_root": str(args.root),
        "run_id": args.run_id,
    }
    if not args.train:
        print(json.dumps(plan, indent=2))
        return

    import torch
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer

    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(TOKENIZER_PATH))
    artifacts = RunArtifacts(str(args.root), args.run_id)
    artifacts.write_json(
        "integrity",
        "config.json",
        {
            "increment": "v1.2.0-increment-1",
            "baseline_checkpoint": str(BASELINE),
            "baseline_checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_sha,
            "tokenizer": str(TOKENIZER_PATH),
            "curriculum_digest": curriculum_digest(),
            "train_examples": len(training_examples),
            "validation_examples": len(validation_examples),
            "steps": args.steps,
            "lr": args.lr,
            "seed": args.seed,
            "max_length": 256,
            "grad_accum": 2,
            "heldout_policy": "AD-1 frozen suite is not used for training",
            "command": f"python scripts/run_v120_increment1.py --train --root {args.root} --run-id {args.run_id} --steps {args.steps} --lr {args.lr} --seed {args.seed}",
        },
    )
    started = time.time()
    result, _model, _config = train_from_checkpoint(
        checkpoint_path=str(BASELINE),
        checkpoint_hash=checkpoint_sha,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        examples=training_examples,
        val_examples=validation_examples,
        lr=args.lr,
        steps=args.steps,
        max_length=256,
        grad_accum=2,
        seed=args.seed,
        artifacts=artifacts,
        device="cpu",
    )
    result["experiment"] = plan
    result["elapsed_seconds_total"] = round(time.time() - started, 2)
    artifacts.finalize({"stage": "train", "increment": "v1.2.0-increment-1", **plan})
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Run the authorized v1.2.0 Increment 10 identifier-aware experiment.

Dry run by default. Training requires BOTH --train and --authorize and
reuses the existing trainer with the Increment 9 identifier-supervision
sidecar enabled (configurable, mean-normalized, single application).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from training.experiment_artifacts import RunArtifacts
from training.v120_experiment10 import (
    DEFAULT_CONFIG,
    combined_training_examples,
    combined_validation_examples,
    experiment_identity,
    identifier_config,
    load_config,
    run_preflight,
)


def _launch_command(config) -> str:
    return (
        "python scripts/run_v120_increment10.py --train --authorize "
        f"--root {config['experiment_root']} --run-id {config['run_id']}"
    )


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run the authorized Increment 10 experiment")
    parser.add_argument("--config", default=str(DEFAULT_CONFIG))
    parser.add_argument("--train", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--authorize", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--root", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", default=None)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    config = load_config(args.config)
    if args.root:
        config = {**config, "experiment_root": args.root}
    if args.run_id:
        config = {**config, "run_id": args.run_id}

    if args.train and not args.authorize:
        print(
            "REFUSED: --train without --authorize. Training requires explicit "
            "authorization via --authorize.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

"""Run the prepared v1.2.0 Increment 3 training experiment.

Default mode is a dry run: it validates the configuration, runs the
pre-training gates, and prints the plan without initializing a training
loop or writing any checkpoint. Real training requires BOTH --train and
the explicit --authorize flag. The frozen baseline is never overwritten;
the run writes only into a new run directory via the existing immutable
RunArtifacts path.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from training.binding_curriculum import build_training_examples, build_validation_examples
from training.experiment_artifacts import RunArtifacts
from training.v120_experiment import (
    DEFAULT_CONFIG,
    GateError,
    experiment_identity,
    load_config,
    run_preflight,
)


def _launch_command(config) -> str:
    return (
        "python scripts/run_v120_increment3.py --train --authorize "
        f"--root {config['experiment_root']} --run-id {config['run_id']}"
    )


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run the prepared v1.2.0 Increment 3 experiment")
    parser.add_argument("--config", default=str(DEFAULT_CONFIG))
    parser.add_argument("--train", action="store_true", help="execute training (also requires --authorize)")
    parser.add_argument("--authorize", action="store_true", help="explicit training authorization")
    parser.add_argument("--root", default=None, help="override experiment root (dry runs only in tests)")
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", default=None, help="override run id")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    config = load_config(args.config)
    if args.root:
        config = {**config, "experiment_root": args.root}
    if args.run_id:
        config = {**config, "run_id": args.run_id}

    if args.train and not args.authorize:
        print(
            "REFUSED: --train without --authorize. Training requires explicit "
            "authorization via --authorize.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)

    preflight = run_preflight(config, authorized=args.authorize, for_training=args.train)
    plan = {
        "mode": "train" if args.train else "dry_run",
        "experiment_identity": experiment_identity(config),
        "architecture": config["architecture"],
        "baseline_checkpoint": config["baseline_checkpoint"],
        "baseline_checkpoint_sha256": config["baseline_checkpoint_sha256"],
        "tokenizer": config["tokenizer"],
        "curriculum_digest": config["curriculum_digest"],
        "train_examples": config["train_examples"],
        "validation_examples": config["validation_examples"],
        "steps": config["steps"],
        "lr": config["lr"],
        "seed": config["seed"],
        "device": config["device"],
        "experiment_root": config["experiment_root"],
        "run_id": config["run_id"],
        "preflight": preflight,
        "launch_command_after_approval": _launch_command(config),
    }
    if not args.train:
        # A dry run surfaces static-gate failures but never writes anything.
        static = [g for g in preflight["gates"] if g["gate"] != "memory"]
        if not all(g["passed"] for g in static):
            print(json.dumps({**plan, "refused": True}, indent=2))
            raise SystemExit(2)
        print(json.dumps(plan, indent=2))
        return

    # --- Training path: only reachable with --train --authorize. ---
    from training.continued_training import train_from_checkpoint

    import torch
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer

    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(config["tokenizer"]))
    training_examples = build_training_examples(seed=config["seed"])
    validation_examples = build_validation_examples(seed=config["seed"] + 1)
    artifacts = RunArtifacts(str(config["experiment_root"]), config["run_id"])
    artifacts.write_json(
        "integrity",
        "config.json",
        {
            "increment": "v1.2.0-increment-3",
            "experiment_identity": experiment_identity(config),
            "config": config,
            "command": _launch_command(config),
        },
    )
    started = time.time()
    result, _model, _config = train_from_checkpoint(
        checkpoint_path=str(config["baseline_checkpoint"]),
        checkpoint_hash=str(config["baseline_checkpoint_sha256"]),
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        examples=training_examples,
        val_examples=validation_examples,
        lr=config["lr"],
        steps=config["steps"],
        max_length=config["max_length"],
        grad_accum=config["grad_accum"],
        warmup=config["warmup"],
        weight_decay=config["weight_decay"],
        grad_clip=config["grad_clip"],
        seed=config["seed"],
        artifacts=artifacts,
        device=str(config["device"]),
    )
    result["experiment"] = {**plan, "preflight": preflight}
    result["elapsed_seconds_total"] = round(time.time() - started, 2)
    artifacts.finalize({"stage": "train", "increment": "v1.2.0-increment-3", **plan})
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Default mode is a dry run: it validates the configuration, runs all

<|file|> F:\Codes\Git\Quantsmind-LLM\scripts\run_v200_cell.py
"""Run one v2.0.0 controlled training cell with immutable artifacts.

Usage:
    python scripts/run_v200_cell.py --run-root <dir> --run-id run-0001 \
        --lr 3e-4 --steps 8 --stage train
    python scripts/run_v200_cell.py --run-root <dir> --run-id run-0001 --stage eval
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

import yaml

from training.contrastive_tasks import (
    build_contrastive_curriculum,
    contamination_report,
    curriculum_digest,
)
from training.experiment_artifacts import RunArtifacts, file_sha256
from training.synthetic_eval import classify_task_conditioning, evaluate_cases_v2
from training.synthetic_train import build_corpus, train_cell

EVAL_CASES = 6
BUDGET = 64


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="v2.0.0 controlled training cell")
    parser.add_argument("--run-root", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=3e-4)
    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--grad-accum", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--context-length", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261021)
    parser.add_argument("--init-checkpoint", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--baseline", default="runs/m7_pretrain/checkpoint_last.pt")
    parser.add_argument("--stage", default="train", choices=["train", "eval"])
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    from tokenizers import Tokenizer

    tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(REPO / "tokenizer" / "qm_code_bpe_v0.json"))
    model_cfg = yaml.safe_load(
        (REPO / "configs" / "model" / "code_m3_9m.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )["model"]

    partitions = build_contrastive_curriculum(args.seed)
    contamination = contamination_report(partitions)
    digest = curriculum_digest(partitions)
    if contamination["contaminated"]:
        print("REFUSED: the contrastive curriculum is contaminated:", contamination["violations"][:3])
        return 2

    if args.stage == "train":
        artifacts = RunArtifacts(args.run_root, args.run_id)
        artifacts.write_json("integrity", "curriculum.json", {
            "digest": digest,
            "contamination": contamination,
            "partitions": {k: [c.to_dict() for c in v] for k, v in partitions.items()},
        })
        config = {
            "lr": args.lr, "steps": args.steps, "grad_accum": args.grad_accum,
            "context_length": args.context_length, "seed": args.seed,
            "init_checkpoint": args.init_checkpoint,
            "baseline_checkpoint": args.baseline,
            "model_config": model_cfg, "curriculum_digest": digest,
            "evaluation_budget": BUDGET, "evaluation_cases_per_partition": EVAL_CASES,
        }
        artifacts.write_json("integrity", "config.json", config)
        result, model = train_cell(
            model_config=model_cfg, tokenizer=tokenizer,
            train_records=build_corpus(partitions, "train"),
            val_records=build_corpus(partitions, "A"),
            lr=args.lr, steps=args.steps, context_length=args.context_length,
            grad_accum=args.grad_accum, seed=args.seed,
            init_checkpoint=args.init_checkpoint, artifacts=artifacts,
        )
        artifacts.write_checkpoint(
            "checkpoint_final",
            {"model": model.state_dict(), "config": {"model": model_cfg}},
        )
        print("train steps", result["steps"], "loss",
              result["initial_loss"], "->", result["final_loss"],
              "val", result["validation_loss"], "tokens", result["tokens_consumed"],
              "seconds", result["elapsed_seconds"])
        return 0

    artifacts = RunArtifacts(args.run_root, args.run_id, create=False)
    from serving.local_inference import load_model

    eval_sets = {
        name: partitions[name][:EVAL_CASES] for name in ("A", "B", "C", "D")
    }
    baseline_path = REPO / args.baseline
    baseline_model, _ = load_model(str(baseline_path), "cpu")
    started = time.time()
    baseline = evaluate_cases_v2(baseline_model, tokenizer, eval_sets, budget=BUDGET)
    trained_path = artifacts.path("checkpoints", "checkpoint_final.pt")
    trained_model, _ = load_model(str(trained_path), "cpu")
    trained = evaluate_cases_v2(trained_model, tokenizer, eval_sets, budget=BUDGET)
    print("eval seconds", round(time.time() - started, 1))
    for label, result in (("baseline", baseline), ("trained", trained)):
        print(label, json.dumps(result["metrics"]))
    metrics = json.loads(
        artifacts.path("metrics", "training.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    loss_delta = None
    if metrics.get("initial_loss") is not None and metrics.get("final_loss") is not None:
        loss_delta = metrics["final_loss"] - metrics["initial_loss"]
    verdict = classify_task_conditioning(trained["metrics"], loss_delta=loss_delta)
    baseline_verdict = classify_task_conditioning(baseline["metrics"])
    print("BASELINE:", baseline_verdict["verdict"], "|", baseline_verdict["reason"])
    print("TRAINED :", verdict["verdict"], "|", verdict["reason"])
    baseline_hash = file_sha256(baseline_path)
    trained_hash = file_sha256(trained_path)
    artifacts.write_evaluation("baseline.json", {
        "run_id": args.run_id,
        "checkpoint_sha256": baseline_hash,
        "checkpoint_path": str(baseline_path),
        "evaluation_suite_digest": digest,
        "generation": {"budget": BUDGET, "decoding": "greedy", "seed": args.seed},
        "metric_version": "v2.0.0",
        "metrics": baseline["metrics"],
        "records": baseline["records"],
    })
    artifacts.write_evaluation("post_train.json", {
        "run_id": args.run_id,
        "checkpoint_sha256": trained_hash,
        "checkpoint_path": str(trained_path),
        "evaluation_suite_digest": digest,
        "generation": {"budget": BUDGET, "decoding": "greedy", "seed": args.seed},
        "metric_version": "v2.0.0",
        "metrics": trained["metrics"],
        "classification": verdict,
        "baseline_classification": baseline_verdict,
        "records": trained["records"],
    })
    artifacts.finalize({
        "schema": "quantsmind.v200_experiment/1",
        "lr": args.lr,
        "steps": args.steps,
        "seed": args.seed,
        "curriculum_digest": digest,
        "baseline_checkpoint_sha256": baseline_hash,
        "trained_checkpoint_sha256": trained_hash,
        "training": {
            "initial_loss": metrics.get("initial_loss"),
            "final_loss": metrics.get("final_loss"),
            "validation_loss": metrics.get("validation_loss"),
            "tokens_consumed": metrics.get("tokens_consumed"),
            "elapsed_seconds": metrics.get("elapsed_seconds"),
        },
        "task_conditioning": verdict,
        "baseline_task_conditioning": baseline_verdict,
    })
    print("finalized", artifacts.path("manifest.json"))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Run the v2.1.0 instruction-to-operation experiment (immutable artifacts).

    python scripts/run_v210.py --run-root <dir> --run-id run-0001 --stage baseline
    python scripts/run_v210.py --run-root <dir> --run-id run-0001 --stage train
    python scripts/run_v210.py --run-root <dir> --run-id run-0001 --stage eval
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

import yaml

from training.experiment_artifacts import RunArtifacts, file_sha256
from training.operation_tasks import (
    build_operation_curriculum,
    contamination_report,
    curriculum_digest,
)
from training.supervised_train import evaluate_supervised, train_supervised

EVAL_PER_PARTITION = 4
BUDGET = 64
TINY_OPERATIONS = ("add", "subtract", "maximum", "minimum")


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="v2.1.0 operation-learning experiment")
    parser.add_argument("--run-root", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=3e-4)
    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--grad-accum", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--max-length", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261021)
    parser.add_argument("--stage", default="baseline",
                        choices=["baseline", "train", "eval"])
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    from tokenizers import Tokenizer

    tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(REPO / "tokenizer" / "qm_code_bpe_v0.json"))
    model_cfg = yaml.safe_load(
        (REPO / "configs" / "model" / "code_m3_9m.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )["model"]
    parts = build_operation_curriculum(args.seed)
    digest = curriculum_digest(parts)
    report = contamination_report(parts)
    if report["contaminated"]:
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSED: contaminated curriculum {report['violations'][:3]}")
    eval_sets = {
        name: parts[name][:EVAL_PER_PARTITION]
        for name in ("T", "V", "H1", "H2", "H3", "C")
    }
    tiny = [e for e in parts["T"] if e.operation in TINY_OPERATIONS][:6]

    if args.stage == "baseline":
        from training.determinism import set_determinism
        from training.model import QMModel

        artifacts = RunArtifacts(args.run_root, args.run_id)
        artifacts.write_json("integrity", "curriculum.json", {
            "digest": digest, "contamination": report,
            "partitions": {k: [e.to_dict() for e in v] for k, v in parts.items()},
        })
        artifacts.write_json("integrity", "config.json", {
            "lr": args.lr, "steps": args.steps, "seed": args.seed,
            "context_length": args.max_length, "grad_accum": args.grad_accum,
            "model_config": model_cfg, "curriculum_digest": digest,
            "evaluation_budget": BUDGET,
            "evaluation_per_partition": EVAL_PER_PARTITION,
            "supervision": "instruction+signature+body, response-only loss mask",
        })
        set_determinism(args.seed)
        model = QMModel(model_cfg)
        artifacts.write_checkpoint(
            "scratch_baseline",
            {"model": model.state_dict(), "config": {"model": model_cfg}},
        )
        started = time.time()
        result = evaluate_supervised(model, tokenizer, eval_sets, budget=BUDGET)
        print("baseline eval seconds", round(time.time() - started, 1))
        for name, metrics in result["metrics"].items():
            print(" ", name, json.dumps(metrics))
        checkpoint_hash = file_sha256(
            artifacts.path("checkpoints", "scratch_baseline.pt")
        )
        artifacts.write_evaluation("scratch_baseline.json", {
            "run_id": args.run_id,
            "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
            "evaluation_suite_digest": digest,
            "generation": {"budget": BUDGET, "decoding": "greedy", "seed": args.seed},
            "metric_version": "v2.1.0",
            "per_partition": result["metrics"],
            "records": result["records"],
        })
        artifacts.finalize({
            "schema": "quantsmind.v210_experiment/1",
            "stage": "baseline",
            "curriculum_digest": digest,
            "scratch_checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
            "per_partition": result["metrics"],
        })
        return 0

    run_dir = Path(args.run_root) / args.run_id
    artifacts = RunArtifacts(args.run_root, args.run_id, create=not run_dir.exists())

    if args.stage == "train":
        result, model = train_supervised(
            model_config=model_cfg, tokenizer=tokenizer,
            examples=parts["T"], val_examples=parts["V"][:8],
            lr=args.lr, steps=args.steps, max_length=args.max_length,
            grad_accum=args.grad_accum, seed=args.seed, artifacts=artifacts,
        )
        artifacts.write_checkpoint(
            "trained",
            {"model": model.state_dict(), "config": {"model": model_cfg}},
        )
        print("train steps", result["steps"], "loss", result["initial_loss"],
              "->", result["final_loss"], "val", result["validation_loss"],
              "tokens", result["tokens_consumed"], "sec", result["elapsed_seconds"])
        return 0

    from serving.local_inference import load_model

    checkpoint = artifacts.path("checkpoints", "trained.pt")
    model, _ = load_model(str(checkpoint), "cpu")
    started = time.time()
    result = evaluate_supervised(model, tokenizer, eval_sets, budget=BUDGET)
    tiny_result = evaluate_supervised(model, tokenizer, tiny, budget=BUDGET)
    print("eval seconds", round(time.time() - started, 1))
    for name, metrics in result["metrics"].items():
        print(" ", name, json.dumps(metrics))
    print("  tiny-set", json.dumps(tiny_result["metrics"]))
    checkpoint_hash = file_sha256(checkpoint)
    artifacts.write_evaluation("trained.json", {
        "run_id": args.run_id,
        "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
        "evaluation_suite_digest": digest,
        "generation": {"budget": BUDGET, "decoding": "greedy", "seed": args.seed},
        "metric_version": "v2.1.0",
        "per_partition": result["metrics"],
        "tiny_set": tiny_result["metrics"],
        "records": result["records"],
    })
    metrics = json.loads(
        artifacts.path("metrics", "training.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    artifacts.finalize({
        "schema": "quantsmind.v210_experiment/1",
        "stage": "eval",
        "curriculum_digest": digest,
        "trained_checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
        "training": {
            "initial_loss": metrics.get("initial_loss"),
            "final_loss": metrics.get("final_loss"),
            "validation_loss": metrics.get("validation_loss"),
            "tokens_consumed": metrics.get("tokens_consumed"),
            "elapsed_seconds": metrics.get("elapsed_seconds"),
        },
        "per_partition": result["metrics"],
        "tiny_set": tiny_result["metrics"],
    })
    print("finalized", artifacts.path("manifest.json"))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

<|file|> F:\Codes\Git\Quantsmind-LLM\scripts\run_v220.py
"""Run the v2.2.0 complete-function and generalization experiment.

    python scripts/run_v220.py --root <dir> --stage freeze
    python scripts/run_v220.py --root <dir> --stage baseline
    python scripts/run_v220.py --root <dir> --stage train --cell A
    python scripts/run_v220.py --root <dir> --stage all
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import gc
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from training.continued_training import train_from_checkpoint
from training.experiment_artifacts import RunArtifacts, canonical_digest, file_sha256
from training.generalization_eval import evaluate_cases
from training.generalization_tasks import (build_cells, build_eval_cases,
                                           eval_digest, validation_cases)
from training.supervised import build_example

TOKENIZER = REPO / "tokenizer" / "qm_code_bpe_v0.json"
DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT = Path(
    r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\v210\runE\checkpoints\trained.pt")
EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT = (
    "02cc86eb64022a454c0c7a795f18507cebbde709f295c65cd990d5e6f837f8ac")
BUDGET = 64
SEED = 20261022


def _tokenizer():
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
    return Tokenizer.from_file(str(TOKENIZER))


def _examples(records, split):
    return [build_example(
        example_id=record["example_id"], instruction=record["instruction"],
        signature=record["signature"], body=record["body"],
        operation=record["operation"], family=record["family"],
        split=split, seed=SEED) for record in records]


def freeze_suite(root: Path):
    directory = root / "frozen"
    path = directory / "eval_suite.json"
    cases = build_eval_cases()
    digest = eval_digest(cases)
    if path.is_file():
        existing = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if existing.get("digest") != digest:
            raise SystemExit("REFUSED: existing frozen suite has a different digest")
        print("frozen suite already present", digest)
        return cases, digest
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    payload = {"version": "2.2.0", "seed": SEED, "budget": BUDGET,
               "digest": digest, "cases": cases}
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
                    encoding="utf-8")
    (directory / "eval_suite.sha256").write_text(
        file_sha256(path) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print("froze", len(cases), "cases", digest)
    return cases, digest


def _load_suite(root: Path):
    path = root / "frozen" / "eval_suite.json"
    if not path.is_file():
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: run the freeze stage first")
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cases = payload["cases"]
    if payload["digest"] != eval_digest(cases):
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: frozen suite digest does not verify")
    return cases, payload["digest"]


def _evaluation(artifacts, model, tokenizer, cases, digest, checkpoint_hash,
                limit=None):
    selected = cases if limit is None else cases[:limit]
    started = time.time()
    result = evaluate_cases(model, tokenizer, selected, budget=BUDGET,
                            device="cpu")
    elapsed = round(time.time() - started, 2)
    payload = {"version": "2.2.0", "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
               "evaluation_suite_digest": digest, "budget": BUDGET,
               "decoding": "greedy", "seed": SEED,
               "cases_requested": len(selected), "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
               "metrics": result["metrics"], "records": result["records"]}
    artifacts.write_evaluation("generalization.json", payload)
    print("evaluated", len(selected), "cases in", elapsed, "s")
    for name, metrics in result["metrics"]["by_partition"].items():
        print(" ", name, metrics["cases"], "exact", metrics["exact"],
              "structural", metrics["structural"],
              "composition", metrics["composition_match"])
    return payload

def _new_run(root: Path, run_id: str):
    target = root / run_id
    if target.exists() and any(target.iterdir()):
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSED: run directory already exists: {target}")
    return RunArtifacts(str(root), run_id)


def run_baseline(root: Path, checkpoint: Path, checkpoint_hash: str, limit=None):
    from serving.local_inference import load_model
    cases, digest = _load_suite(root)
    artifacts = _new_run(root, "baseline")
    artifacts.write_json("integrity", "config.json", {
        "version": "2.2.0", "checkpoint": str(checkpoint),
        "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
        "evaluation_suite_digest": digest, "budget": BUDGET,
        "decoding": "greedy", "seed": SEED,
    })
    model, _config = load_model(str(checkpoint), "cpu")
    _evaluation(artifacts, model, _tokenizer(), cases, digest, checkpoint_hash,
                limit=limit)
    artifacts.finalize({"stage": "baseline", "version": "2.2.0",
                        "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
                        "evaluation_suite_digest": digest})
    print("baseline finalized")


def run_cell(root: Path, cell: str, checkpoint: Path, checkpoint_hash: str,
             *, lr: float, steps: int, grad_accum: int, limit=None):
    key = cell.replace("_repeat", "")
    cells = build_cells()
    records = cells[key]
    validation = validation_cases()
    cases, digest = _load_suite(root)
    artifacts = _new_run(root, f"cell{cell}")
    artifacts.write_json("integrity", "config.json", {
        "version": "2.2.0", "cell": key, "repeat": cell != key,
        "checkpoint": str(checkpoint), "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
        "evaluation_suite_digest": digest, "lr": lr, "steps": steps,
        "grad_accum": grad_accum, "seed": SEED, "budget": BUDGET,
        "train_examples": len(records), "validation_examples": len(validation),
    })
    result, model, _config = train_from_checkpoint(
        checkpoint_path=str(checkpoint), checkpoint_hash=checkpoint_hash,
        tokenizer=_tokenizer(), examples=_examples(records, "train"),
        val_examples=_examples(validation, "validation"), lr=lr, steps=steps,
        grad_accum=grad_accum, seed=SEED, artifacts=artifacts, device="cpu",
    )
    trained_hash = result["checkpoint_sha256"]
    _evaluation(artifacts, model, _tokenizer(), cases, digest, trained_hash,
                limit=limit)
    artifacts.finalize({"stage": "train", "version": "2.2.0", "cell": key,
                        "repeat": cell != key,
                        "base_checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
                        "trained_checkpoint_sha256": trained_hash,
                        "evaluation_suite_digest": digest,
                        "train_examples": len(records),
                        "tokens_consumed": result["tokens_consumed"]})
    del model
    gc.collect()
    print(f"cell {cell} finalized")


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="v2.2.0 experiment")
    parser.add_argument("--root", default=r"C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\v220")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", default=str(DEFAULT_CHECKPOINT))
    parser.add_argument("--stage", default="all",
                        choices=["freeze", "baseline", "train", "all"])
    parser.add_argument("--cell", default=None, choices=["A", "B", "C", "C_repeat"])
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=None,
                        help="smoke-test only: evaluate the first N cases")
    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=1e-4)
    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=150)
    parser.add_argument("--grad-accum", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--allow-other-checkpoint", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    import torch
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    root = Path(args.root)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    checkpoint = Path(args.checkpoint)
    if not checkpoint.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"checkpoint missing: {checkpoint}")
    checkpoint_hash = file_sha256(checkpoint)
    if not args.allow_other_checkpoint and checkpoint_hash != EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT:
        raise SystemExit("REFUSED: checkpoint hash differs from the frozen v2.1.0 checkpoint")

    if args.stage in ("freeze", "all"):
        _cases, digest = freeze_suite(root)
        print("suite digest", digest)
    if args.stage == "freeze":
        return 0
    if args.stage in ("baseline", "all"):
        run_baseline(root, checkpoint, checkpoint_hash, limit=args.limit)
    if args.stage in ("train", "all"):
        selected = [args.cell] if args.cell else ["A", "B", "C", "C_repeat"]
        for cell in selected:
            run_cell(root, cell, checkpoint, checkpoint_hash, lr=args.lr,
                     steps=args.steps, grad_accum=args.grad_accum,
                     limit=args.limit)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

<|file|> F:\Codes\Git\Quantsmind-LLM\scripts\scale_corpus.py
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from data.build_code_corpus import process_local_files, chunk_code, is_minified, has_valid_structure
from data.filters import ExactDedup, MinHashDedup, quality_check, scrub_pii

corpus_path = Path("data/code_corpus_v0.jsonl")
stats_path = Path("data/code_corpus_v0.stats.json")

dedup = ExactDedup()
fuzzy = MinHashDedup()
stats = {
    "seen": 0,
    "kept": 0,
    "rejected_quality": 0,
    "rejected_dup": 0,
    "rejected_fuzzy": 0,
    "rejected_minified": 0,
    "rejected_syntax": 0,
    "chunks_emitted": 0,
    "by_language": {},
    "by_source": {},
}

items = []
for root_dir in [".", "training", "serving", "evaluation", "tokenizer", "data", "scripts", "tests"]:
    p = Path(root_dir)
    if p.exists():
        items.extend(process_local_files(p))

print(f"Total items: {len(items)}")

with corpus_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for text, lang, source in items:
        stats["seen"] += 1
        if is_minified(text):
            stats["rejected_minified"] += 1
            continue
        if not has_valid_structure(text, lang):
            stats["rejected_syntax"] += 1
            continue
        ok, _ = quality_check(text, 100, 100_000, 0.3)
        if not ok:
            stats["rejected_quality"] += 1
            continue
        for piece in chunk_code(text, 200):
            if not dedup.add(piece):
                stats["rejected_dup"] += 1
                continue
            if not fuzzy.add(piece):
                stats["rejected_fuzzy"] += 1
                continue
            clean = scrub_pii(piece)
            f.write(json.dumps({"text": clean, "language": lang, "source": source}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            stats["kept"] += 1
            stats["chunks_emitted"] += 1
            stats["by_language"][lang] = stats["by_language"].get(lang, 0) + 1

stats_path.write_text(json.dumps(stats, indent=2))
print(f"seen={stats['seen']} kept={stats['kept']} chunks={stats['chunks_emitted']}")
print(f"by_language={stats['by_language']}")
